snippet.title: One Neck Ahead - First Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4870100/One_Neck_Ahead/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=long&utm_campaign=wishlist_push

One Neck Ahead is an upcoming, retro-style 2d platformer in which you play as Kid Giraffe as you travel to the heart of the forest. A whole story about a baby giraffe, friendship, and loss.

The core mechanic: Carry a collectible box with you and activate it at any moment. Find out how it interacts with the many other mechanics!
